units.source_text: 夕雾与柏木同车，一路上相与谈话。

en.t: Yugiri rode in the same carriage with Kashiwagi, and they talked together all along the way.

units.source_text: 夕雾对柏木言道：“近来寂寞无聊，不如到六条院来玩玩，可以散心解闷。

en.t: Yugiri said to Kashiwagi, "Since things have been lonely and dull lately, why not come to Rokujo-in for a visit and ease your mind?

units.source_text: 父亲说过：‘最好拣个像今天那样的闲暇日子，趁春花尚未散落之时到这里来玩。’

en.t: My father said, 'It would be best to choose a quiet day like today and come here while the spring blossoms have not yet fallen.'

units.source_text: 月内哪一天，你可带了小弓来此，同时还可观赏春花呢。”

en.t: Sometime this month, you could bring your small bow here and enjoy the spring flowers as well."
He arranged a date with Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 两人在归途中谈天说地。

en.t: The two of them chatted about all sorts of things on the way home.

units.source_text: 柏木一心想谈三公主之事，便对夕雾说道：“听说你家六条院父亲一直住在紫夫人那里。

en.t: Kashiwagi, intent on speaking about the Third Princess, said to Yugiri, "I hear that your father at Rokujo-in has been staying all this time with Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 他对这位夫人的宠爱真是特殊的了！

en.t: His affection for that lady really is exceptional!

units.source_text: 但不知三公主作何感想。

en.t: But I wonder what the Third Princess thinks of it.

units.source_text: 她一向是朱雀院非常宠爱的掌上明珠，如今孤居寂处，太委屈了，真可怜啊！”

en.t: She was always the dearly treasured daughter of Suzaku-in, and now she lives alone in lonely seclusion; it is too unfair, and truly pitiful!"
He spoke without the slightest restraint.

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“你不要胡说，岂有这等事！

en.t: Yugiri replied, "Do not talk nonsense. There is no such thing!

units.source_text: 紫夫人情形不同，是从小教养大来的，所以特别亲切，不好同别人相比。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's situation is different; she was raised by him from childhood, so they are especially close, and she cannot be compared with others.

units.source_text: 至于三公主，父亲无论在哪方面都非常重视她呢。”

en.t: As for the Third Princess, my father values her very highly in every respect."

units.source_text: 柏木说：“好了好了，免开尊口吧。

en.t: Kashiwagi said, "Enough, enough. Spare me your fine explanations.
I know all about the true circumstances.

units.source_text: 三公主不是常常在受气么？

en.t: Isn't the Third Princess constantly being made to suffer?

units.source_text: 朱雀院对她的宠爱无以复加，而如今这般委屈，令人真不可解。”

en.t: Suzaku-in loved her beyond measure, and yet now she is treated so unfairly; it is truly incomprehensible."
